instruction: Disable the cone splash screen icon in VLC's interface settings.

metadata.trajectory_summary: Agent successfully opened GNOME Settings, navigated to Default Applications, and changed the default video player from Videos to VLC media player in 9 turns.
metadata.capability_extraction: Can open system Settings via Activities search, navigate sidebar menus, use dropdown selectors to change settings
metadata.task_rationale: Tests the agent's ability to navigate VLC's own preferences and find the interface setting to disable the background cone, requiring exploration of VLC's preference panels
metadata.explanation: Task requires opening VLC, navigating to Tools > Preferences > Interface, and unchecking the background cone option. Evaluator closes VLC to save config, then reads vlcrc to check qt-bgcone value equals 0 (disabled).

llm_judge_reasons: Getter vlc_config correctly reads the VLC configuration file (vlcrc) from the VM, which contains the qt-bgcone setting
Metric check_qt_bgcone correctly parses vlcrc for the 'qt-bgcone=' line and compares its value to the expected value of 0 (disabled)
Expected value 0 correctly represents the disabled state of the cone splash screen icon in VLC
Postconfig correctly kills VLC before reading config, ensuring settings are flushed to disk
Parameter handling is correct: with type='rule', get_rule returns {'expected_qt_bgcone': 0} and the metric accesses rule['expected_qt_bgcone'] directly
Default value handling is correct: metric defaults qt_bgcone to '1' (enabled) if key not found, matching VLC's actual default
Complete coverage: the single instruction requirement (disable cone) is fully verified by the evaluator
